title: Don't Starve
notes: Candidate v4 uses five complete native survival days for 100 points and three-second frozen steps. After a native first-night calibration failure, a fixed undeveloped Wilson world is prepared with the official Long Day world option and DLC disabled under the team permission to lower unsuitable difficulty. Native HUD size 10 improves readability. All four cells share controls-v4, including inventory hotkeys, all click-target coordinates and native panel navigation. Autonomous first-night calibration must pass before a fresh formal campaign. No successful v4 calibration or formal result is claimed yet; historical definitions and evidence remain unchanged.
introduction: Don't Starve is a real-time survival and crafting game with continuous survival rather than a finite ending in this setting. A trial starts Wilson in an undeveloped first-day base-game world with DLC disabled and the official Long Day option, retaining a day/dusk/night cycle. The trial's frozen rubric defines the native-day target and milestones. Only continuous survival within one episode earns points; optional crafting earns no points. Death may start a fresh language-model episode within the original budget; Jev ends at its first death. This setting does not measure Adventure Mode completion.
controls: W/A/S/D move. Space performs a nearby contextual action. F attacks a nearby target. Left click performs the primary action at the pointer. Right click performs the secondary action at the pointer; the current typed-choice profile cannot express right clicks. Escape opens or closes menus, Tab toggles the map, Q/E rotate the camera, and Return confirms menu selections. Scroll changes zoom or scrolls the visible interface. These are ordinary input bindings, not a strategy. Number keys 1 through 9 and 0 activate the native action for items in inventory slots 1 through 10. The native mouse-operated crafting bar uses left clicks to toggle category tabs and pointer hover to select entries; clicking an entry or its native button activates it. The separate keyboard-operated crafting panel uses W/S to select a category, A/D to select an entry, and Space to activate the current selection. In that keyboard panel, a mouse click activates the current selection; moving the pointer does not select another entry.
